name: io.github.wiresage/mikrotik-mcp
description: MCP server for MikroTik routers: firewall, NAT, routing, DHCP, DNS, WireGuard and more via SSH.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IP address or hostname of the MikroTik router (single-device mode; default: 127.0.0.1). Not needed when an inventory is configured.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: SSH username for the MikroTik router (single-device mode; default: admin)

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: SSH password for the MikroTik router (single-device mode)

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: SSH port of the MikroTik router (single-device mode; default: 22)

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_KEY_FILENAME
environmentVariables.description: Path to SSH private key file for key-based authentication (single-device mode)

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: When true, expose only tools that do not modify RouterOS or its file store. Use a read-only RouterOS account as defence in depth.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_SENSITIVE_HIDING
environmentVariables.description: When true, redact recognized credentials and private key material from tool results, MCP notifications, and logs, and omit tools that return opaque sensitive payloads.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_INVENTORY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a YAML file listing multiple MikroTik devices (title, host, port, username, password, key_filename, tags, region). See docs/reference/devices/inventory.md.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_INVENTORY
environmentVariables.description: Inline multi-device inventory as a YAML (or JSON) list; takes precedence over MIKROTIK_INVENTORY_FILE and the single-device variables. Holds credentials.
